summary: Pelican Acquisition II Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the closing of its initial public offering of 8,625,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, generating $86.25 million gross proceeds. Sponsor purchased 334,000 private placement units and EarlyBirdCapital purchased 86,250 private placement units for $4.2 million. Net proceeds of $87.1125 million placed in trust. This is a routine SPAC IPO closing report, not a special situation.
